content.text:
Changing `getPiiFreeCredential` could break about 25 files: 7 that call it directly and 18 that call a function that does. I found these with a text search of imports and call sites. The graphify graph is heuristic, so I used it only as a starting point. I didn't open the callers to confirm each uses the changed function. The last three test files below import modules whose functions reach it, but they may only mock them.

**Direct callers (7 files)**
- `packages/lib/piiFreeData.ts` calls it inside `getPiiFreeUser`.
- `packages/app-store/utils.ts` calls it in `getApps`.
- `packages/app-store/getVideoAdapters.ts`
- `packages/features/conferencing/lib/videoClient.ts` calls it in `createMeeting` and `deleteMeeting`.
- `packages/features/calendars/lib/getCalendarsEvents.ts`
- `packages/features/calendars/lib/CalendarManager.ts` calls it in `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent`.
- `packages/features/bookings/lib/EventManager.ts` calls it in `createAllCalendarEvents`.

**Two levels out (18 files)**
- Callers of `getPiiFreeUser`:
  - `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/ensureAvailableUsers.ts`
  - `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleNewBooking/loadAndValidateUsers.ts`
- Callers of `getApps`:
  - `packages/app-store/_utils/getDefaultLocations.ts`
  - `packages/app-store/_utils/getEnabledAppsFromCredentials.ts`
  - `packages/platform/libraries/app-store.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/apps/updateUserDefaultConferencingApp.handler.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/apps/appById.handler.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/apps/appById.handler.test.ts` (test)
- Callers of the `videoClient` functions (`createMeeting`, `deleteMeeting`):
  - `packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts`
  - `packages/app-store/vital/lib/reschedule.ts`
  - `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/requestReschedule.handler.ts`
  - `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleSeats/lib/lastAttendeeDeleteBooking.ts`
  - `packages/platform/libraries/conferencing.ts`
- Callers of the `CalendarManager` functions (`updateEvent`, `deleteEvent`):
  - `packages/platform/libraries/index.ts`
  - `packages/features/calendars/lib/CalendarManager.test.ts` (test)
- Caller of `getCalendarsEvents`:
  - `packages/features/calendars/lib/getCalendarsEvents.test.ts` (test)
- Test files that import `CalendarManager`:
  - `packages/features/busyTimes/services/getBusyTimes.test.ts` (test)
  - `packages/app-store/_utils/payments/handlePaymentSuccess.test.ts` (test)

`createAllCalendarEvents` is private to `EventManager.ts`, so its callers stay inside that file. `EventManager`'s public methods have their own callers, but those are three levels out, so I left them out. Some API v2 files, such as `conferencing.service.ts`, also reach `getApps` through `packages/platform/libraries`. They sit at that same third level.
